hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was turned on (ramped from off to on starting in the 22:42 minute), and the new code path divides by zero when rendering account pages. Error rate jumped from ~1% to ~30-40% in exactly the minute the flag began evaluating 'on', and every error is a ZeroDivisionError. The earlier remediation did not help because the flag is still evaluating 'on' after it — the change log records Argus switching monthly-spend-feature back *on* at 2026-09-15T22:50:43Z and logs at 22:51 still read 'monthly-spend-feature=on'. Turning it genuinely off (and confirming the evaluation logs read off) should clear it.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero (first appears in the same minute the flag starts evaluating on)
error_rate jumps from 0.005 at 22:41 to 0.305 at 22:42 and stays 0.28-0.42 thereafter, request_volume unchanged at 1200
INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations / account pages rendered normally (baseline before onset)
feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor: admin)
feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor: Argus) — the flag is on again after the attempted mitigation
INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations, still ZeroDivisionError, error rate 32%

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: a latent defect in the currently deployed build is exposed only by the monthly-spend code path, so the true fix is a rollback rather than a flag change. However, no deploy or other change to io-shop is recorded anywhere from 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z through the incident, so this is unsupported by anything retrieved.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-15T22:42:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)
